importReadiness.summary: Section 8 has enough official source, GPX/API/OSM geometry, facilities, commute/access, field-report and rules/safety evidence for normalization. It is not ready for direct runtime import because Böne's printed coordinate typo must be corrected, Prångens and Böne endpoint/access semantics must be modeled separately, Jordkulan overnight/water status needs cautious treatment, Böne transit is weak and water/service claims are limited.
importReadiness.descriptionDraft: Etapp 8 runs from Prångens Camping in Ulricehamn to Böne kyrka. The route starts on the old railway embankment, now an asphalt walking/cycling path, then continues on gravel roads, forest roads and some paths toward Böne. It overlaps briefly with Åsundenleden near the start and shares a longer northern section with Redvägsleden before the trails split. Prångens/Ulricehamn has strong services at the start; Jordkulan i Nöre is the major mid/late-stage heritage and rest cluster with shelter, fireplace, toilet and picnic facilities, but water there is not reliable. Böne kyrka is the endpoint with parking and heritage context, but weak public transport and no confirmed potable water.
importReadiness.recommendedGeometry: Use Naturkartan Etapp 8 GPX/API as the primary geometry, preserving its three-part MultiLineString structure or bridging the small inter-track gaps intentionally.
